userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Show the crew how many panels a job needs
userStories.story: As a delivery crew member, I want to see the number of panels required on the installation record, so that I load the right quantity on the van.
acceptance: A Panels Required field exists on Installation
It is visible to the crew permission set
It appears on the Installation record page

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Let the crew leave notes on an installation
userStories.story: As a delivery crew member, I want a free text notes field and a list view of my open installations, so that I hand over cleanly to the next shift.
acceptance: A Crew Notes field exists on Installation
A My Open Installations list view exists
The crew permission set grants the field

userStories.author: marco
userStories.title: Cap the crew size a planner can assign
userStories.story: As a planner, I want the assignment flow to refuse a crew larger than the installation allows, so that we stop over-staffing small jobs.
acceptance: Installation_Assign_Crew checks the cap
Planners can override it

userStories.author: amina
userStories.title: Generate a quote PDF from an opportunity
userStories.story: As a sales rep, I want a button that generates the quote PDF, so that I stop rebuilding it in a spreadsheet.
acceptance: The permission is granted to managers

userStories.author: marco
userStories.title: Refactor InstallationScheduler
userStories.story: As a developer, I want the scheduler split into testable methods, so that we stop being afraid of it.
acceptance: Behaviour unchanged
Coverage above the threshold

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Warn the planner when a crew is too small
userStories.story: As a planner, I want a warning on the installation when the assigned crew is smaller than the job needs, so that I fix it before the van leaves.
acceptance: The flow reads Crew Size
A warning is shown
userStories.seededFailure: The Crew Size field is excluded by an over-eager .forceignore entry, so the flow deploys against a field that is not in the package

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Crew size becomes mandatory
userStories.story: As a planner, I want Crew Size to be mandatory on every installation, so that no job is scheduled without a crew.
acceptance: Crew Size is required
Existing records are backfilled with the default of 2
userStories.seededFailure: The permission sets still grant field level security on the field, which a required field cannot have, so the deployment fails on them. Once that is fixed the deployment goes green and silently makes the 30 installations with no crew size unsaveable, because Salesforce enforces a required field on save rather than on the data already there

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Crew capacity reference data and nightly recalculation
userStories.story: As a planner, I want capacity rules per crew type and a nightly job that recalculates them, so that the planning board is right every morning.
acceptance: 12 Crew Capacity records exist in every org
The batch is scheduled nightly
The planning board setting is on
userStories.seededFailure: The feature is silently inert after deployment because the reference records and the schedule exist in no org

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Check several installations against panel availability at once
userStories.story: As a planner, I want to check a list of installations against panel availability in one go, so that I can fill a week of planning without opening every record.
acceptance: InstallationScheduler returns the installations that can take a crew on a given day
Coverage stays above the threshold
userStories.seededFailure: The obvious implementation queries inside its loop, which PMD warns about, and the new branch has no test, which drops coverage below the threshold and blocks the deployment

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Crews can read the panel batch cost
userStories.story: As a delivery crew member, I want to see the cost of the batch I am installing, so that I report damage with the right value.
acceptance: The crew can read Panel Batch Cost
userStories.seededFailure: The permission was granted on a Profile that overwrite management protects, so the deployment is green and the permission is missing

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Flat roofs need a crew of at least three
userStories.story: As a planner, I want the assignment flow to put at least three people on a flat roof, so that the ballast is carried safely.
acceptance: Installation_Assign_Crew raises the crew on flat roofs
Marco crew cap from US-018 still wins when the two disagree
userStories.seededFailure: Marco US-018 merged first and touched the same flow and the same permission set

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Tidy the Installation layout
userStories.story: As a planner, I want Crew Size above Install Date on the installation layout, so that I see the staffing before the date.
acceptance: Crew Size sits above Install Date on the Installation layout
userStories.seededFailure: None. The lab is about publishing far too much and recovering from it

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Installation handover checklist
userStories.story: As a planner, I want a handover checklist on the installation with its reference items, so that a job is only closed when the checklist is complete.
acceptance: A Handover_Item__c object exists
10 reference checklist items are loaded in every org
The close flow blocks on an incomplete checklist
userStories.seededFailure: Combines the dependency error of US-021, the data action of US-026 and a conflict with a teammate branch

userStories.author: you
userStories.title: Installations can no longer be saved
userStories.story: As a planner, I want to be able to save an installation whose date is already in the past, so that I can update a job that has slipped.
acceptance: The date validation rule only fires when the date is changed
Completed installations stay exempt
userStories.seededFailure: The validation rule shipped without ISCHANGED, so it refuses every save of an old record
